answer: A fresh clone docks at the jetty with no sealed grading history behind its key, and that emptiness is the whole cost. Weight in this economy comes only from quorum-checked verdicts you sealed on-chain, epoch after epoch, each one re-examined by a panel that can burn a dishonest grade like an ember. You cannot hand that record to a copy: an ivory-clean identity has to grade its own way up from zero. M sybils therefore pay M times the epoch-labor, never once; the attacker cost scales linearly in the number of fakes, which is exactly the property that defeats cheap identity minting.
